purpose: Determine whether the current official V2XScenes release configuration implements the paper's stated 80/20 sequence split, while keeping any statement about published benchmark numbers outside the evidence boundary.

externalPrimarySources.title: V2XScenes: A Multiple Challenging Traffic Conditions Dataset for Large-Range Vehicle-Infrastructure Collaborative Perception
externalPrimarySources.paperClaim: The implementation-details section states that the V2XScenes sequences were split into an 80% training set and a 20% test set.

externalPrimarySources.accessCondition: The README requires an access request before downloading the dataset.

evidenceLines.observation: Vehicle-pose files are selected from train_scenario_list when train is true and test_scenario_list otherwise.
scenario_folders is built directly from the selected scenario list; no sequence-level 80/20 subdivision is applied here.
The loader iterates each configured scenario folder and enumerates all matching label files.
For the vehicle stream, sorted label and point-cloud files from the selected folder are added to the scenario database without an internal train/test partition.

staticFindings.interpretation: Under the audited loader, equal root directories plus equal scenario lists select the same scenario folders in train and evaluation modes. This is an executable release-contract mismatch with the paper's stated 80/20 protocol.

evidenceLines.observation: The entrypoint loads one YAML and builds train=True and train=False datasets from it.
The resulting datasets are used directly for the training and validation DataLoaders.
The train=False loader controls validation loss and best-checkpoint selection.

staticFindings.interpretation: If either audited YAML is run unchanged against matching data folders, the configured train and validation scenario selections are not disjoint.

dataLevelStatus.reason: The official release requires an access request; no authorized dataset object was available in the current environment.

supported: Both official V2XScenes YAML files currently present in the audited commit define identical train and test scenario sets.
The audited loader selects whole configured scenario folders and does not implement an internal 80/20 sequence split in the inspected path.
The official training entrypoint constructs training and validation datasets from those two list selections.
The current release configuration does not, by itself, encode the paper's stated 80/20 sequence protocol.
notSupported: The paper's published ICCV tables were generated with either current YAML.
Every authorized dataset package has identical file contents under the listed scenario names.
The repository authors intended train/test overlap rather than shipping an example or stale configuration.
A corrected split necessarily changes AP or MOTA by a particular amount.
claimBoundary.requiredLanguage: Call this a confirmed current-release configuration and loader contract mismatch. Do not call it paper leakage until checkpoint provenance and data-level key/hash overlap are established.

candidateHardGates.passCondition: Obtain V2XScenes through the official access process and record the package version, archive hashes, and license.
Instantiate train=True and train=False datasets from each shipped YAML and export canonical sample keys before loading point tensors.
Hash the referenced label, point-cloud, and calibration files and report path and content intersections separately.
Link any tested checkpoint or author-provided command to the paper's reported protocol before discussing table validity.
Publish a deterministic, condition-stratified 80/20 sequence split with zero clip, timestamp-neighborhood, and content-hash overlap.

stage1CpuOnly: Parse every official V2XScenes YAML and fail closed when canonical train and test sample identities intersect.
Emit path, inode-independent content hash, parent sequence, condition label, and time-neighborhood groups.
Construct a deterministic group split that preserves the paper's 80/20 sequence-level ratio and reports condition coverage.
stage2OneGpu: Re-evaluate one officially supported baseline under the shipped and corrected splits with model, augmentation, and training budget frozen.
Report paired per-sequence AP, MOTA, effective sample count, and condition-stratified uncertainty.
Treat a near-zero difference as a valid negative result; the release-contract correction remains useful independently of metric direction.
stoppingRules: Stop the paper-validity claim if no checkpoint or command can be linked to the reported tables.
Stop the leakage claim if canonical train/test keys and file hashes are disjoint after authorized data enumeration.
Publish the validator and corrected split even when the metric delta is negligible.

directCollisionSearch.boundary: Absence of a GitHub issue is not proof of literature novelty; a separate multi-source novelty review is still required.

decision.panelPositioning: Executable benchmark-protocol audit and corrected split artifact, not an accusation about published results.
